svg.font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Bayu Indoor schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of the Bayu Indoor node: XIAO ESP32-S3, Plantower PMS5003 on the UART, SCD40 and SHT40 breakouts on I2C, optional button and WS2812 LED. Connections are made by net name.
svg.text: Same net name, same wire. Dashed parts are optional or live on a breakout board.
D3: battery sense, Bayu Power only.
5 V / 2 A wall supply into the
Core board only. On the breadboard
5 V fan and laser, 3.3 V logic
pick a module rated for 3.3 V
The SCD40 and SHT40 boards bring their
own pull-ups, so R5 and R6 stay out.
Close JP1 for a bare sensor only.

g.text: CERN-OHL-W-2.0 · Meaningful Design Group / Fab Lab Bali · github.com/Meaningful-Design-Group/makingsensebali
